name: bento-grid
title: Bento grid
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Responsive bento layout. Each cell asks for a span and stacks to one column at 390px.

meta.descriptionEs: Acomodo bento. Cada celda pide su tramo y a 390 px queda en una columna.

scenes.label: Cargando
scenes.descriptionEs: El muro anuncia que está cargando.

scenes.label: Texto largo
scenes.descriptionEs: Un título con un token de 60 caracteres.

scenes.label: Sin CTA
scenes.descriptionEs: La celda no muestra una llamada a la acción.

examples.title: Muro
examples.description: Cuatro celdas. A 390 px se apilan.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 390 px, token largo, RTL, cero, una, diez, carga y error.

meta.usage:
<BentoGrid label="Studio wall" columns={4}>
  <BentoCell span={{ col: 2, row: 2 }}>
    <BentoFeatureCard title="North kiln" description="Morning shift." href="#kiln" cta="View schedule" />
  </BentoCell>
</BentoGrid>

api.name: columns
api.description: Desktop column count. Default 4. One column through 390px, two from 30rem, full count from 56rem.

api.name: gap
api.description: Spacing step. Default md, which is gap-4.

api.name: status / emptyLabel / loadingLabel / errorLabel
api.description: Empty, loading, and error replace the cells and are not links.

api.name: BentoCell span
api.description: Requested span. Columns clamp to 1 until 30rem and to 2 until 56rem.

api.name: BentoCell asChild
api.description: Render the child element, such as an article, instead of a list item.

api.name: preset
api.description: magnetic keeps the published MagneticBento breakpoints. Hosts should use the default.

docs: Inspiración visual, sin código. Fuente: https://shadcnstudio.com/blocks/bento-grid/bento-cards. Licencia: bloques Pro de shadcn/studio, fuera del repositorio MIT de shadcn/ui. No se copió código, markup ni assets. A container of 390px stays on one column. Two columns start at 30rem (480px). The requested column count starts at 56rem (896px). Gap uses the spacing scale. Ready cells enter with opacity and translateY. The last cell waits at most 0.4s. Reduced motion sets that duration to 0. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
